description: This Java class implements a visitor pattern to collect subject IDs with specific permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources, ignoring revoked permissions. It evaluates permissions hierarchically and determines if subjects meet the expected permission criteria.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor that collects subject IDs with specific permissions granted, based on a resource pointer and permission set.

classes.name: ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class that evaluates permissions for a specific subject ID on resource nodes.

methods.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Visits a tree node, delegating to subject or resource node handlers.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles subject nodes, creating evaluators for each subject.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Handles resource nodes, aggregating permissions for the current evaluator.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the set of subject IDs that meet the permission criteria.

methods.name: aggregateWeightedPermissions
methods.description: Aggregates permissions from a resource node for a specific subject.

methods.name: getLocationInRelationToTargetPointer
methods.description: Determines the position of a resource node relative to the target pointer.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates if the subject's permissions meet the expected criteria and updates the result set.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyRevoked
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively revoked for the subject.

methods.name: areExpectedPermissionsEffectivelyGranted
methods.description: Checks if permissions are effectively granted for the subject.
